[[File:Mirabounty.png|thumb|200px|Mira wearing her ballistic mesh jacket]]
This '''ballistic mesh jacket''' was the personal property of [[Mira]], one of the [[Lost Jedi]] and companion of the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], during her career as a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. An exceptionally protective jacket, it was comparable to medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]], albeit much less restrictive, and protected its owner from various melee weapon damage.

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only the playable character Mira can equip this article of clothing.
